name: UnpackMusicTar
author: homelab
about: Safely extracts ZIP and tar-family archives for the music category.
requirements: Optional VerifyAudio setting requires ffmpeg in the NZBGet runtime
description: Extracts zip, tar, tar.gz, tgz, tar.bz2, tbz2, tar.xz, and txz files.
Flattens archive and existing release folders while retaining numbered CD, Disc, and Disk directories, including mix and edition labels.
Restores missing or misleading extensions for recognizable media, including files named like sidecars.
Removes confirmed image, PDF, or text sidecars with accurip, jpg, log, m3u, m3u8, md5, nfo, nzb, pdf, pls, png, sfv, srr, toc, txt, and url extensions.
Recognises binary SRR recovery sidecars by their bounded ReScene marker and application header, retaining unknown binary content and cue-referenced files.
Matches scene playlist hash suffixes and featured-artist labels, and accepts repeated ancillary MusicBrainz tags without discarding album completeness metadata.
Rejects zero-byte audio files before any cleanup or publication, even without track totals or optional decoding verification.
Checks local M3U-style playlists for missing tracks, including extensionless lists and matching obfuscated single-album FLACs by track number, artist and title; retains ambiguous lists.
Retains cue sheets and unidentified files, and rejects duplicate archive file paths before extraction.
Updates cue FILE references when tracks move or receive extensions, and processes nested supported archives.
Preserves cue encodings and line endings, including UTF-16 BOMs, and resolves disposable sidecar conflicts across separate archives.
Validates the complete staged release before publication, rolls back ordinary write failures, and retains recovery files after an interrupted publication.
Identifies tagless MP3, ADTS AAC, and AIFF audio, reports processing counts and unidentified files, and skips publication for unchanged releases.
Offers explicit --preview and checksum-verified --recover commands for a selected release or retained workspace.
Skips failed or repairable NZBGet downloads without cleanup and validates tagged FLAC track counts within separate album/disc groups.
Optionally decodes recognised audio with ffmpeg before publication; errors preserve originals and archives. Protect .cue files with NZBGet RenameIgnoreExt.
Recognises CP437 box-art scene NFO sidecars with printable ASCII text, while retaining unknown binary files and cue-referenced sidecars.
Runs only for the music category and removes archives after successful extraction.

options.name: VerifyAudio
description: Decode recognised audio with ffmpeg before cleanup and publication. Requires ffmpeg in the NZBGet runtime; missing tools, decoding errors or a ten-minute per-file timeout fail without changing originals.
